boundaries: Prepared-only recovery authenticates expected bytes and original directory identities, then establishes the first marker file identities; it does not prove no earlier same-bytes replacement.
Existing Registry constructors reject the v2 markers; component binding, reserved namespace fallback protection and runtime inventory remain follow-up work.
Bootstrap directory flush measurement does not attest marker directory fsync or physical power-loss durability.
verificationNotes: Initial regression failure was an exact retention allowlist test missing the new dedicated legal type; one expected entry was added and the complete file rerun.

Intermediate native runs included helper startup failures, a generic parent-permission HOLD whose native detail was not preserved, three original 60-second test timeouts with Vitest STACK_TRACE_ERROR reporting, and a secondary undefined prepared-record error in the formerly broad v1-race assertion.
Astra confirmed the permission result schema and the Vitest timeout stack/report defect. No validator, native helper budget, test deadline or platform condition was loosened.

Only affected cases were retried serially. Ownership tests gained native permission-call observation, and the v1 race now requires EEXIST and an actual injected winner; the modified cases were checked separately.

Two monolithic behavior tests were replaced by six focused cases with all assertions retained. Native backend initialization and real provisioning now each have their own unchanged 60-second setup budget; each behavior case and all native helper deadlines remain unchanged. One ancestor-after-inspection case was added without platform skips.

An intermediate shared-fixture beforeAll containing both native setup operations exceeded its original 60-second budget and left five cases unexecuted; the final setup stages are independent, and no passing claim is made for that failed run.

Committed idempotent finish now returns its first complete bookended readback instead of repeating an identical read with no intervening mutation. Protected ancestor layouts are rejected before the native helper, and valid fresh requests repeat the ancestry check afterward before allocation.

reviews.astra: read-only review completed; required implementation findings fixed, documented prepared-only identity limit corrected
